summary: Interpreted the corrected install-snapshot experiment (CheckRun e5116cfe896549deb27799d6d871ed77, exit 0, tests_passed). Parsed index 1 shows the leader snapshotting at index 8 while the added voter was isolated. Parsed index 2 shows that voter afterwards installing the snapshot (installed_index=8, snapshot_index=8, applied and commit 8) while its log store's last index was only 5, so store_emptied=true and should_snapshot=true under otherwise default follower settings. The install path's compaction respects the trailing-log count, so older entries below the installed snapshot index survive and the node's store sits below its snapshot index, making the unsigned delta underflow; runSnapshots then schedules a snapshot at the unchanged index each interval until the follower's log grows past the snapshot index. Recorded as violated with defect_claim asserted, extending the same defect's reachability to a normal follower catch-up event and removing the earlier 'install route only predicted' limitation, with limitations keeping the consequence bounded to redundant snapshot creation (no safety effect), noting the leader-side TrailingLogs=0 used to force the snapshot, and noting the single in-process execution.
